Talent Brew field

Job Description:

Assessed Internship Brazil – Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Join us as a Shell Assessed Intern and you can be a part of the future of energy.

Together we are transitioning to become a net-zero emissions business while providing the energy that people around the world need today.

Working with experienced colleagues on these important challenges, you'll have the opportunity to grow your skills– in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another.

Whichever part of our business you join, you will have the chance to work with experienced colleagues and share your unique perspective and fresh ideas on how to tackle energy-related challenges. That's why we're looking for interns who share our purpose and passion for progress.

Our inclusive and collaborative culture will equip you with the support you need to forge your own path and grow your skills as you work on meaningful projects with exciting responsibilities right from the start.

At Shell you can power your progress as we tackle the energy challenge together.

Develop the energy solutions of tomorrow and today

How can the world transition to net zero emissions while providing the secure, affordable energy that powers lives? You'll get the opportunity for hands-on experience of projects that are helping to meet this challenge. By working with experienced colleagues who bring expertise from a range of areas, you will have the chance to help drive change in the energy system.

Grow your skills: learn today, lead tomorrow

When you join, you'll be assigned to a role with exciting challenges and opportunities. You'll be supported in crafting a development journey tailored to your strengths and needs with the opportunity to work on a variety of projects at the forefront of technologies, trends and practices.

Shell's 'learner mindset' environment helps unlock the potential in each of us, creating a supportive, high-performance environment based on openness, curiosity and growth, where you can learn from experiences and build the skills that let you grow today and lead in future.

Collaborate with experienced colleagues

With access to a global network of expertise you can make meaningful connections and continue your growth and learning at Shell. We invite people to think differently and learn from the diversity of backgrounds, cultures, ideas and knowledge at Shell

Achieve balance in a values-led culture

We live our core values of honesty, integrity and respect, so you can work in an environment that encourages you to be the best version of yourself and respects the individual journeys that each of us will take.

Shell Brazil

Shell has been operating in Brazil since 1913, focusing on meeting global energy needs and accelerating the energy transition responsibly across economic, environmental, and social spheres. Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Shell Brasil employs around 700 people in various sectors including Exploration and Production, Natural Gas, Trading, Research & Development, and Renewable Energy Development.

Key Highlights:

  • Exploration and Production: Shell is a leading company in this area, facing significant technological challenges in the Upstream segment. It was the first private company to produce oil commercially in Brazil's Campos Basin.
  • Downstream Segment: Includes Raizen, a joint venture for sugar and ethanol production, electric power generation, and fuel distribution for retail and commercial sectors. Raizen also recently acquired Shell Brasil's lubricants business.

WHAT'S THE ROLE?

Power Your Progress

An Assessed Internship is an excellent way to get to know Shell from the inside and immerse yourself in the energy industry. It can also help you decide what career is right for you. You'll have full day-to-day involvement in actual projects, selected to match your interests and abilities. You'll join a project team and work alongside Shell employees who are all professionals in their fields. Their perspectives will contribute to your understanding of our business, its demands and rewards.

A supervisor and mentor will support you directly and you'll undertake regular assessments throughout your internship to ensure you get the most from the experience. As part of the Assessed Internship, you'll have a formal mid-term review with your supervisor and mentor. At the close of your internship, you will be asked to prepare a presentation about your project and there will be discussion on project delivery and performance by your supervisor and mentor.

  • Up to 2 years in the chosen business area.
  • A real project with a significant level of business impact.
  • Discovering which skills you need to develop, through constructive feedback.
  • Developing valuable networks and contracts for future career opportunities.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

You should enjoy being challenged, so that rather than being daunted or overwhelmed if a task seems impossible, you welcome the opportunity to be innovative. You also need to be good at absorbing information, analysing problems, making objective decisions, and coming up with original ideas. You should have the drive, and resilience to get things done, the flexibility to work well as part of a team and the credibility to influence others.

To be eligible for the Shell Assessed Internship:

  • You should be an actively enrolled student who will complete you graduation in at least 1,5 years from the Internship beginning.
    Shell matches you into a particular programme based on your skills and preference. If you are a student from one of the following courses, we look forward to meet you : Economics; Human Resource; Geology.

Join the Shell Assessed Internship Programme and Power Your Progress.

Before applying, you are advised to read our data protection policy. This policy describes the processing that may be associated with your personal data and informs you that your personal data may be transferred to Shell/Shell Group companies around the world. The Shell Group and its approved recruitment consultants will never ask you for a fee to process or consider your application for a career with Shell. Anyone who demands such a fee is not an authorised Shell representative and you are strongly advised to refuse any such demand. Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Port Captain
description:
PORT CAPTAIN – OPERAÇÕES OFFSHORE E&P

Petra Group Executive Search

A Petra Group está assessorando um cliente do setor de engenharia submarina na busca por um Port Captain altamente experiente, rigoroso em segurança e capaz de garantir excelência operacional em frota offshore.

Se você conhece o peso da responsabilidade sobre uma embarcação e sabe liderar equipes marítimas em operações críticas, esta posição exige exatamente esse nível de maturidade técnica.


Responsabilidades Principais

Supervisão Operacional da Frota

  • Gerenciar a operação diária das embarcações, assegurando eficiência, segurança e cumprimento dos planos.

  • Monitorar KPIs, consumos, disponibilidade e performance operacional.

  • Validar relatórios, análises de risco e documentação de navegação.

Conformidade e Segurança Marítima

  • Garantir conformidade com STCW, ISM, ISPS, SOLAS e normas aplicáveis.

  • Conduzir inspeções internas e apoiar auditorias de classe, bandeira e cliente.

  • Gerenciar procedimentos de emergência e SMS.

Gestão de Tripulação

  • Coordenar escalas e movimentação de tripulantes.

  • Avaliar Masters, Chief Officers e engenheiros de bordo.

  • Implementar boas práticas e reforçar disciplina operacional.

Integridade Técnica e Manutenção

  • Suportar o time de manutenção na execução dos planos preventivos e corretivos.

  • Acompanhar docagens, reparos e inspeções de classe.

  • Garantir alta disponibilidade operacional.

Cliente e Projetos Offshore

  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e alinhamentos operacionais.

  • Garantir aderência das embarcações aos requisitos de engenharia submarina.

  • Acompanhar mobilização, certificações e documentação.

Operações Portuárias e Logística

  • Coordenar bunkering, suprimentos, cargas e equipamentos subsea.

  • Planejar movimentação de ROVs, spreads de mergulho e ferramentas especiais.

  • Gerenciar fornecedores e operadores portuários.


Requisitos

Requisitos

  • Formação em Náutica, Engenharia Naval ou afins.

  • Experiência prévia como Oficial de Náutica ou Master Mariner, preferencialmente no offshore.

  • Vivência com embarcações PSV, AHTS, MPSV, DSV ou similares.

  • Fluência em espanhol e/ou inglês é diferencial.

Certificação Marítima / Habilitações

  • COC (Certificate of Competency) válido para Oficial de Náutica ou Master Mariner.

  • STCW completo, incluindo:

    • Basic Safety Training (BST)

    • Advanced Fire Fighting (AFF)

    • Proficiency in Survival Craft and Rescue Boats (PSCRB)

    • Medical First Aid / Medical Care (conforme nível exigido)

    • GMDSS (quando aplicável)

  • Certificação ISM Code / Auditor Interno (desejável).

  • Certificação ISPS – SSO / CSO (altamente desejável).

  • HUET / BOSIET / FOET (dependendo da área de operação offshore).

  • Certificados de Familiarização com DP (DP Awareness desejável quando a frota utilizar DP).

Outras Certificações Relevantes

  • Atualizações de STCW (refresher).

  • Certificação de SMS / Gestão de Riscos (diferencial).

  • Cursos voltados a operações offshore e subsea (ROV, Diving Support, handling de cargas especiais) serão considerados diferencial competitivo.


Benefícios

Benefícios (Resumo)

  • Salário compatível com o mercado offshore.

  • Bônus por performance.

  • Plano de saúde + seguro de vida.

  • Ajuda de custo para viagens e inspeções (diárias/per diem).

  • Alimentação e transporte (ou reembolso).

  • Hospedagem nas operações fora da base.

  • Reciclagens e certificações STCW/HUET custeadas.

  • Oportunidades de crescimento para Marine Superintendent, Fleet Manager ou posições de gestão operacional.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel você será responsável, principalmente, pela operação do fluxo de entrada e saída de alunos, bem como das rotinas escolares e orientação de convivência escolar. Deve ser uma pessoa proativa, organizada, resiliente, cordial, ter facilidade em se comunicar e se relacionar com jovens e adultos e ser capaz de lidar com o ambiente dinâmico de uma escola (esta é uma vaga temporária de licença maternidade).

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Receber e registrar a entrada e saída de alunos, responsáveis e visitantes, garantindo o controle de acesso e a segurança no ambiente escolar;
  • Zelar pela boa convivência e harmonia entre os membros da comunidade escolar, intervindo quando necessário para resolver conflitos e promover um clima positivo;
  • Organizar e supervisionar os diversos setores da escola, assegurando que as instalações estejam em boas condições, ordenadas e propícias ao aprendizado;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outros setores da escola, garantindo a comunicação e ações coordenadas para o bom funcionamento das atividades educacionais e administrativas;
  • Executar tarefas adicionais de natureza similar e complexidade, de acordo com as demandas da escola e sob a orientação da liderança;
  • Seguir e aplicar os valores, diretrizes e procedimentos estabelecidos pela Escola, promovendo a adesão à cultura organizacional;
  • Priorizar a segurança e bem-estar dos alunos, tomando medidas para garantir um ambiente livre de riscos e perigos;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar parceiros e alunos envolvidos em atividades extracurriculares, garantindo que todas as atividades estejam alinhadas com os padrões de segurança e comportamento esperados;
  • Organizar, executar e viabilizar a logística de eventos escolares que podem ocorrer em alguns sábados letivos.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência lidando diretamente com jovens e adolescentes.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas;
  • Simplicidade e qualidade na realização de tarefas;
  • Boa comunicação e gosto por trabalho em equipe.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Freelance GenAI Developer
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English.

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project ) and help shape the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and Vibe Coding work together seamlessly.

As a Vibe Coding Expert, you'll partner with systems that take on repetitive tasks, while you provide the nuance, judgment, and creativity needed to deliver outstanding results.

In this role, you won't just refine what Vibe Coding generates — you'll actively collaborate with it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real-world use. Your day-to-day work may range from tackling complex challenges across different domains with the support of automation, to producing well-reasoned, precise, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.

This flexible, part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with technical expertise and hands-on experience in scripting, automation, or AI-driven tools. Your contributions will directly influence how Vibe Coding systems evolve, learn, and empower industries worldwide.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a project, and your typical tasks may include:

  • Your mission - deliver well-reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.
  • Solve complex tasks in different domains with the help of automations
  • Develop and submit precise answers based on complex prompts, including coding, automation, and data processing tasks.
  • Write and optimize Python scripts for data analysis, automation, and verification.
  • Work with large datasets efficiently, ensuring data is clean and well-structured.
  • Utilize various LLMs to generate advanced prompts and improve AI output quality.
  • Format outputs in required structures such as Markdown, JSON, tables, etc.
  • Identify and troubleshoot non-trivial technical problems related to AI workflows and integrations.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects that match your technical skills, on your own schedule. From coding and automation to fine-tuning AI outputs, you'll play a key role in advancing AI capabilities and real-world applications.

  • You hold a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields.
  • You have a minimum of 1 year of professional experience in AI automation, data engineering, or software development is desirable.
  • Your level of English is upper-intermediate (B2) or above.
  • Strong data analysis and automation skills, with experience in scripting (e.g., Python) for task efficiency.
  • Proficient in working with large datasets and integrating data from multiple sources.
  • Ability to develop, test, and optimize AI-driven workflows and tools.
  • Detail-oriented mindset to ensure accuracy and quality in data processing and output
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem-solving.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $7/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

description:

O Agente de Sucesso do Cliente é o elo estratégico que conecta nossos produtos ao sucesso real dos nossos usuários. Você não só resolve, mas prevê necessidades, identifica as maiores oportunidades de crescimento e transforma a satisfação do cliente em fidelidade e receita. Sua atuação é fundamental para a reputação e o crescimento da nossa marca no mercado.

Suas Atribuições e Impacto

Prepare-se para atuar como consultor e estrategista da satisfação:

  • Atendimento que Inspira: Realizar um atendimento personalizado e consultivo, mergulhando nas necessidades do cliente para oferecer soluções que realmente façam a diferença.
  • Gestão de Relacionamento: Construir e nutrir um relacionamento próximo e empático com a nossa base, transformando clientes em verdadeiros fãs da marca.
  • Agendamento e Follow-up: Gerenciar sua agenda com excelência, agendando contatos estratégicos e garantindo que o acompanhamento das demandas seja impecável.
  • Estrategista de Crescimento: Não apenas atender, mas identificar proativamente oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell, oferecendo produtos e serviços que otimizam os resultados dos clientes.
  • Excelência Contínua: Participar ativamente de treinamentos e capacitações imersivas para ser sempre a referência em conhecimento técnico e de mercado.
  • Colaboração Integrada: Ser o ponto focal de comunicação, colaborando ativamente com Vendas e Times Técnicos para que as soluções sejam entregues de forma rápida e fluida.
  • Padrão Ouro: Buscar a excelência máxima em cada interação, superando expectativas e garantindo uma taxa de fidelização invejável.
  • Mente Organizada: Registrar e documentar todas as interações de forma impecável em nossos sistemas, garantindo a integridade dos dados e a inteligência do negócio.
  • Suporte Estratégico: Atuar como um apoio fundamental para os times comerciais e de atendimento, encaminhando demandas complexas para garantir que cada cliente chegue à solução ideal.

O que Buscamos em Você (Requisitos)

  • Experiência Desejada: Vivência prévia em atendimento ao cliente, relacionamento ou área comercial/vendas.

Valorizamos o seu desempenho e o seu bem-estar. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote que garante sua segurança e motivação:

title: Gerente Técnico de Óleo e Gás
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Gerente Técnico de O&G foco, para integrar nossa equipe. Este papel é fundamental para o desenvolvimento de inovações em um dos principais players do mercado brasileiro de petróleo no segmento upstream, no contexto do seu programa de aumento de eficiência operacional.

Esse(a) profissional irá atuar tecnicamente na identificação de oportunidades de aumento de eficiência operacional, realizar análise de riscos para novas tecnologias, propor novas soluções, atuar como líder técnico da equipe do projeto, buscar sinergias entre as iniciativas e trazer boas práticas do mercado de O&G.

É essencial ter experiência e conhecimento técnico sobre o processo produtivo de O&G offshore, incluindo sistemas submarinos e topside, além de amplo conhecimento da cadeia de O&G, especialmente sobre o segmento upstream. Necessário excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, e capacidade de condução de eventos e reuniões.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais Atividades

  • Apoiar tecnicamente a coordenação do programa de eficiência;
  • Identificar oportunidades de ganhos de eficiência em todas as iniciativas;
  • Avaliar tecnicamente a evolução das perdas de produção através da análise de dados;
  • Sugestionar o desenvolvimento de novas iniciativas ou ampliação de escopo nas existentes;
  • Aprimorar métricas de avaliação de ganhos aferidos pelas iniciativas;
  • Identificar sinergias entre as iniciativas do programa;
  • Orientar tecnicamente todos os profissionais responsáveis pela interação com as iniciativas em cada um dos seus pilares de Eficiência, Integridade e Conformidade e SMS, com foco na operação e manutenção no offshore;
  • Efetuar interlocução técnica com a equipe de gestão de projetos, traduzindo adequadamente as demandas do programa, facilitando a elaboração e entregas/produtos solicitados;
  • Correlacionar boas práticas do mercado de O&G com as adotadas no programa;
  • Apoiar na análise de riscos das iniciativas;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outras equipes e parceiros de negócios para identificar ganhos além da eficiência;
  • Fornecer relatórios e apresentações regulares aos stakeholders do programa de aumento de eficiência, a fim de mantê-los informados sobre o progresso e os resultados alcançados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação

  • Superior completo em Engenharia Química ou Engenharia Mecânica.

Competências Necessárias

  • Experiência comprovada em operação ou manutenção de unidades de produção offshore (não serão consideradas experiências offshore em embarcações de apoio ou de perfuração);
  • Conhecimento profundo sobre o segmento upstream, tanto subsea quanto topside;
  • Experiência como líder no segmento de O&G e habilidade de gestão de equipes;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e tomadas de decisões;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e habilidade para navegar em ambientes inovadores;
  • Inglês avançado;

Competências Desejáveis

  • Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos tradicionais e ágeis;
  • Habilidades de valoração de projetos para tomada de decisão de investimento;

Requisitos:

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time

title: Director, School Counseling and University Admissions
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations' lives?

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Director of School Counseling and University Admissions to serve as a critical bridge between our A-level and US curriculum pathways. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on student counseling to ensure every CGA student receives world-class university guidance while building scalable systems that maintain excellence as we grow.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in both US and UK education systems, demonstrated success in placing students in top universities globally, and the vision to create comprehensive programs that develop future-ready students. This role requires someone who can work directly with students requiring personalized counseling while simultaneously building the infrastructure, playbooks, and training materials that enable consistent counseling quality across our global team.

Purpose

Support students across both curriculum pathways (A-level and US) to help ensure a unified approach to setting students up for success and consistency of practice for academic excellence. This role acts as a bridge between the two curriculum pathways, ensuring that students have the support they need to choose the path that best aligns with their future goals. You'll provide hands-on student counseling support for top universities, support clubs, create enrichment programs, and build scalable systems to ensure students arrive at the application stage well-prepared with strong academic foundations, examination results, rich extracurricular profiles, global competencies in real-world experiences, and clear university pathways aligned to personal goals and CGA's institutional strengths.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Cross-Pathway Leadership & Coordination

  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practice exchange between campuses and across curriculum types (A-level and US pathways)

  • Collaborate with academic staff, admissions teams, and deans to align curricular offerings with student outcomes and market demand

  • Monitor and benchmark academic performance across campuses and curricula to drive continuous improvement

  • Ensure consistency of practice for academic excellence across both curriculum pathways

  • Work as part of an extended team across time zones to support our global nature

    • Examination Management & Academic Performance

  • Support examination management across A-levels, AP, and SAT programs

  • Develop and oversee comprehensive exam preparation programs across all curricula

  • Implement data-driven strategies to improve student outcomes

  • Support accreditation and compliance for institutional relationships

    • Academic Enrichment & Future-Ready Student Development

  • Create programs that develop globally competitive students prepared for the future of work

  • Support and coordinate academic competitions to build student competitiveness

  • Develop real-world experiences and vibrant community connections for students

  • Support student clubs and enrichment programs

  • Ensure students develop strong academic foundations, rich extracurricular profiles, and global competencies

  • Build connections between students and opportunities that develop future-ready skills

    • Clubs & Extracurricular Programs

  • Design and implement a comprehensive club structure and system across CGA that ensures consistency and quality

  • Support student clubs and organizations to foster community connection in a virtual environment

  • Create frameworks and guidelines for club formation, leadership, and sustainability

  • Develop and maintain a diverse portfolio of extracurricular opportunities aligned with university admissions expectations

  • Ensure student leadership development through club participation and officer roles

  • Monitor club engagement and participation to identify opportunities for student connection

  • Build partnerships with external organizations to provide authentic extracurricular experiences

  • Track and document student extracurricular involvement for university applications

  • Create virtual and asynchronous club opportunities that accommodate students across time zones

    • Direct University Admissions Counseling

  • Deliver world-class university admissions counseling through direct student support

  • Work directly with a select cohort of high-intensity students requiring comprehensive personalized counseling

  • Provide strategic planning for university applications, including subject selection and pathway decisions

  • Manage predicted grades and letters of recommendation for students

  • Guide students through UCAS, Common App, and country-specific application systems

  • Ensure students meet all deadlines across multiple application systems globally

  • Review and provide feedback on personal statements, essays, and supplemental materials

  • Provide comprehensive guidance on university selection across US, UK, Canadian, European, Australian, Asian, and other international systems

  • Coordinate financial aid and scholarship applications with families

  • Maintain current knowledge of admissions requirements, deadlines, and trends across global universities

    • Building Scalable Systems & Infrastructure

  • Build scalable systems that ensure all CGA students receive expert guidance through their application process

  • Create comprehensive counseling playbooks and frameworks for counselors and deans to follow

  • Develop standardized processes for predicted grades, recommendation letters, and application quality assurance

  • Build training materials and resources to establish consistent counseling quality across the team

  • Establish quality standards and benchmarks for university counseling

  • Design asynchronous resources supporting part-time students through their application journeys

  • Develop and maintain an extensive database of university programs, scholarships, and requirements globally

  • Build systems that can evolve as our school grows

    • Data & Performance Tracking

  • Support data dashboards tracking application progress and outcomes for areas of improvement

  • Ensure data is transparent and reportable across all school leadership

  • Track and analyze university admissions outcomes to inform program improvements

  • Generate reports on student outcomes and program metrics

  • Use data to identify trends and optimize counseling strategies

    • Strategic Partnerships & Market Intelligence

  • Monitor global education and admissions trends to adjust CGA's approach and maintain competitive advantage

  • Cultivate relationships with university admissions offices to enhance CGA's institutional reputation

  • Build partnerships with universities to create opportunities for CGA students

  • Represent CGA at virtual university fairs and recruitment events

  • Stay informed about test-optional policies, holistic admissions trends, and evolving university requirements

    • Student Support & Academic Advising

  • Advise students on course rigor, AP subject selection, A-level subject combinations, prerequisites, and graduation requirements

  • Provide counseling to address academic stress, time management, and study skills

  • Support students navigating the unique challenges of online learning

  • Serve as an advocate for student needs within the school community

  • Coordinate with families through virtual information sessions and regular communication

  • Create learning environments where every student discovers and develops their unique strengths

    • Administrative & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate student records and university application tracking systems

  • Prepare school reports, transcripts, and counselor recommendation letters

  • Collaborate with school leadership on policy development and strategic planning

    • LEADERSHIP VALUES & APPROACH

    As a leader across pathways at CGA, this role will need to be an exemplar of our values:

  • Unlock Potential Together: We work collaboratively. No team is an island. Adapt quickly and find solutions that are in the best interests of our families and CGA as a whole. Every student is a VIP. Make decisive actions to propel us forward through a lens of optimism.

  • Rethink, Rebuild: Avoid defaulting to, "We've always done this."Be curious, look outside your sphere of inspiration, and dive into the data for actionable insights. Online is our advantage. Let's make the most of the innovation at our fingertips. Take immediate action to improve always, take accountability, follow through, and get ready to optimize again.

  • Raise the bar, compound impact: Continually strive to be better tomorrow. Have high standards for yourself and those around you. Tackle hard things with grit, take your work seriously, but not yourself. Take the time to document work, proactively share learnings, and multiply others' efforts. Give credit to those making a positive impact.

    • QUALIFICATIONS


    Education & Credentials

  • Master's degree in School Counseling, Guidance Counseling, Higher Education, or related field

  • Valid school counseling credential/license (or equivalent from home country)

  • Demonstrable expertise in both US and UK education systems

    • Experience

  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience in high school college counseling or university admissions

  • Proven track record of successfully placing students in competitive universities globally

  • Experience building scalable systems, frameworks, or programs in an educational setting

  • Experience working with international students or in an international school setting

  • Demonstrated knowledge of university admissions processes in multiple countries (US, UK, Canada, Europe, Asia, Australia)

  • Deep experience with both AP and A-level curriculum pathways

  • Familiarity with online/virtual education delivery

  • Experience with data analysis and using metrics to drive program improvement

    • Knowledge & Skills

  • Expert knowledge of US university admissions (Common App, Coalition App, UC system, liberal arts colleges, Ivy League)

  • Expert knowledge of UK university admissions (UCAS, Russell Group, requirements for Oxbridge)

  • Working knowledge of university systems in Canada, Australia, Europe, and Asia

  • Understanding of international baccalaureate equivalencies and credit transfers

  • Proficiency with student information systems and college planning software (Naviance, Scoir, Cialfo, or similar)

  • Strong knowledge of scholarship and financial aid resources globally

  • Familiarity with FERPA, GDPR, and educational privacy laws

  • Ability to develop training materials, playbooks, and scalable processes

    • Technical & Communication Skills

  • Excellent virtual communication and presentation skills

  • Proficiency with video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams)

  • Strong written communication skills for emails, reports, recommendation letters, and counseling materials

  • Ability to use learning management systems and collaboration tools

  • Digital literacy and comfort with educational technology

  • Experience with data visualization and dashboard creation for tracking outcomes

title: Online Teachers for AP Spanish
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations' lives?

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

Job Summary
Join our global team as an online
teacher for our United States Diploma Program
and immerse yourself in a premium one-on-one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student's unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you'll deliver
US curricula
, making a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver personalized, high-quality instruction in a one-on-one virtual setting, adapting to each student's unique learning needs.
  • Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment.
  • Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes.
  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.
  • Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience.
  • Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth.
  • Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA's rich resource library.
  • Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access.

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor's degree or higher in education with a minimum of 15 credit hours in the subject you wish to teach.

  • Or a minimum of a bachelor's degree in the subject area you wish to teach with a minimum of 3 years of teaching experience in a school setting with grades 6-12.

  • Ability to adapt instruction to meet the diverse needs of students.

  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of US Diploma Curricula
  • The ability to dedicate at least 15-20 hours weekly for 6-9 months once you take a student.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years of teaching experience in a school setting (please note, while valuable, we are unable to count tutoring experience towards this requirement).
  • A degree in education or state teaching license.
  • Prior classroom teaching experience in grades 6-12.
  • Prior experience teaching online.
  • Familiarity with creating or adapting curriculum materials.

About Crimson Global Academy
CGA is a world-class online school delivering live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

We Are Doing This By

  • Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age.
  • Fostering a global community that broadens students' perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage.
  • Providing cutting-edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child's education.

If you're passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one-on-one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning, apply now

To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories.

title: Tax Jr Analyst
description:
About The Role
We are looking for a
Junior Tax Analyst
to support our Tax Team with Brazilian tax demands. This role is a great opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to deepen their experience in tax compliance within a dynamic, global, and technology-driven environment. You will work closely with accounting, finance, and external partners to ensure our tax processes in Brazil run smoothly and in full compliance with legislation.

About The Team
Our VTEX Tax Team manages every aspect related to tax planning and compliance, focusing on accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement of our global tax operations. In Brazil, the team plays a critical role in ensuring compliance with local requirements while collaborating with other regions to maintain alignment with global standards.As part of this team, you will:

  • Support tax and accounting activities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax regulations;
  • Review and assist in preparing Direct and Indirect Tax calculations and returns;
  • Register and reconcile journal entries related to tax accounts (recoverable, payable, and expense accounts);
  • Keep the accounting reconciliations for tax accounts updated and accurate;
  • Support the implementation and improvement of SOX controls;
  • Stay up to date with changes in Brazilian tax legislation, sharing key updates with the team;
  • Help clarify withholding tax questions from internal stakeholders;
  • Assist in preparing documentation for tax audits and inspections;
  • Collaborate with local and global teams to ensure alignment between tax, accounting, and finance processes.

Who You Are

  • You are based in Rio de Janeiro and willing to go to the office 1–2x a week;
  • You have a Bachelor's degree (completed or in progress) in Accounting, Business Administration, Law, Economics, or related areas;
  • You have 1–2 years of experience in Tax or Accounting, ideally in a corporate environment or consulting firm;
  • Basic to solid understanding of Brazilian tax legislation;
  • Knowledge of journal entries and reconciliation of tax accounts (assets, liabilities, and P&L);
  • Someone with previous experience with SAP or other ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail;
  • Advanced user of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets;
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset;
  • Intermediate English - comfortable reading documentation and communicating with global peers when necessary;

About VTEX
VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2.4 thousand global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3.4 thousand active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, For more information, visit

If you want to add this: We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees scattered across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia.

At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.

Benefits

  • Annual profit-sharing program
  • Health, dental, and life insurance with national coverage provided by VTEX
  • Annual budget for professional development
  • Language development incentive program (English, Spanish, Portuguese)
  • Flexible meal allowance
  • Extended parental leaves
  • Child-care assistance
  • Flexible work schedule and remote-first culture
  • Financial assistance to build your work-from-home setup
  • Wellness program
  • Free shipping on 1000+ VTEX stores

title: Performance Portfolio Reviewer
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations' lives?

Crimson Education is a global EdTech company founded in 2013 with the idea that through personalised education and technology, we can transform students into the world leaders of tomorrow. We're the world's leading college admissions consultancy, with over 1,330 Ivy League offers and 2,140 to the US Top 15. With a passionate team of 800+ that's rapidly expanding across 30 markets, our unique tech platform connects expert-led guidance and proven data-driven strategies from 3,000 tutors and mentors with students worldwide. We help ambitious students unlock their dream career pathways, and Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League. What sets us apart is our unmatched scale and expertise. We have the largest team of Former Admissions Officers and College Counselors globally. Every student is matched with a carefully-chosen team of admissions experts who laser focus on different parts of their college application — from essays to extracurriculars — ensuring every detail is expertly executed. Valued at over $1B NZD and backed by over $147M NZD in funding from top-tier global investors, including Tiger Global and Ice House Ventures, we are just getting started. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal. Read the article here.

This is a contracted, fully remote position.

What are the main responsibilities for this role?

  • Provide comprehensive and constructive feedback on students' portfolios for conservatoire and other performance programmes, focusing on content, delivery and techniques.
  • Identify students' strengths and areas for improvement, offering strategic advice to enhance their portfolios and chances for admission
  • Stay informed about current trends and expectations at top performance programmes in the US and UK to provide relevant guidance.
  • Maintain a high standard of professionalism and confidentiality in handling students' personal information and application materials.
  • Participate in Crimson Education's training to stay aligned with our goals, methodologies and technology development

What skills and experience are required?

  • A minimum of a performance or other relevant degree, including personal experience with portfolio construction
  • Experience in performance admissions, particularly with assessing applicant portfolios.
  • In-depth understanding of the admissions processes and expectations for performance programmes and expectations .
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to inspire students while providing rigorous and insightful feedback.
  • Proven track record of helping students succeed in competitive admissions settings
  • Ability to create a supportive and encouraging environment while maintaining high standards of critique.
  • Organisational skills to manage multiple arts portfolio reviews efficiently.

Why work for Crimson?

  • Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work
  • Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year
  • Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team
  • Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by
  • We're a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe.

If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you

Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

title: Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Company Description

Talan – Positive Innovation

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

Talan at a Glance

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we've built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we're on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

Our Core Areas of Expertise

  • Data & Technologies: We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.

  • Cloud & Application Services: We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.

  • Management & Innovation Consulting: We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.

Job Description

As a Cloud Architect, reporting to the Head of BaaS Engineering at CIB, your mission will be to design architecture patterns and solutions in Public/Private Cloud, ensuring their adoption in the various areas of CIB. You will also be key in automating CI/CD and IaC processes to improve the efficiency and scalability of the infrastructure.

We need someone like you to help us in different areas:

Design and implementation of cloud architectures:

  • Analyze and design infrastructure pattern architectures in the public cloud (AWS/Azure).
  • Develop infrastructure designs tailored to each use case, translating pattern architecture into the reality of each project.
  • Ensure compliance with the group's reference standards for the public cloud and provide feedback in internal forums.

Automation and optimization:

  • Automate and develop the infrastructure pattern catalog.
  •  Implement and manage IaC (Infrastructure as Code) tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions.

Collaboration and Advisory:

  • Advise the CIO teams of CIB on the adoption of public cloud technologies.
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to ensure the smooth integration of cloud solutions.

Qualifications

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR

EXPERIENCE

  • More than 5 years of experience in infrastructure architecture, databases, and networks.
  • More than 3 years of experience in design, implementation, or consulting of distributed applications.
  • More than 3 years of experience in evaluating technologies and cloud platforms.
  • More than 3 years of experience in design, consulting, or implementation of cloud solutions (microservices, Big Data, hybrid clouds).
  • More than 2 years of experience in IaC tools and automation processes.
  • Experience in presenting technical solutions to different audiences.

EDUCACIÓN

  • Bachelor or Degree in Engineering.
  • Certification in Azure / AWS. (Desirable)

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

  • Cloud architecture and operation: advanced experience with Azure and AWS.
  • DevOps and CI/CD: practical knowledge of GitHub Actions and other continuous integration/delivery processes.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation: experience with Terraform, Crossplane, Ansible, and similar tools.
  •  Experience with platform solutions such as Backstage or Humanitec (desirable) and knowledge of state-of-the-art platform engineering architecture and strategies.
  • Programming languages: Python, Go, Bash, with a focus on automation.
  • Communication and presentation skills: ability to convey technical ideas clearly and effectively.
  • Languages: high level of English (oral and written).

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

  • Full-time contract.
  • Smart Office Pack so that you can work comfortably from home. 
  • Training and career development.
  • Benefits and perks such as private medical insurance, life insurance.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.
  • This is a hybrid position based in Málaga, Spain.  Relocation is mandatory.
  • Possibility to manage work-permits.

If you are passionate about development & tech, we want to meet you

  • Monitorar o abastecimento e exposição de produtos no salão de vendas de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos pela empresa; mantendo o ambiente abastecido, organizado e agradável.

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Especialista de Inclusão
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We're a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we've grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it's time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Quer fazer parte de uma empresa líder mundial em saúde do consumidor que tem como propósito entregar a maior saúde diária com humanidade? Quer contribuir para impactar a vida de bilhões de pessoas por meio de grandes e reconhecidas marcas, como Sensodyne, Centrum, Advil, Eno, Sonrisal, Corega, CataflamPro, Sonridor e outras, e poder ir além em um ambiente que celebra a diversidade?

Então, confira a oportunidade abaixo e venha fazer parte do nosso time Haleon

A/o Especialista de Inclusão & Pertencimento tem como objetivo principal liderar e impulsionar a evolução da empresa nesta jornada. Este papel é fundamental para a implementação e promoção de soluções inovadoras que apoiam a estratégia global da empresa, com foco especial em Mulheres na Liderança e Equidade de Gênero, Raça, Etnia e Inclusão Cultural, assim como o pertencimento das pessoas LGBTQIAPN+ e inclusão e desenvolvimento das Pessoas com Deficiência.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenvolver e Implementar Estratégias: Criar, implementar e gerenciar estratégias eficazes locais de diversidade, equidade e inclusão que promovam um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, a partir das diretrizes globais.
  • Educação e Treinamento: Desenvolver e ministrar programas de treinamento e educação para aumentar o letramento, conscientização e compreensão dos temas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão em toda a organização.
  • Parcerias Internas: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os líderes de times para integrar as práticas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão em todas as operações e estratégias da empresa.
  • Monitoramento e Avaliação: Responsável por monitorar, avaliar e relatar o progresso da empresa em relação aos objetivos de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão. Isso inclui a realização de pesquisas e censos, análise de dados de diversidade e garantia de conformidade com todas as leis e regulamentos pertinentes.
  • Representação e Parcerias: Atuará como um defensor interno para questões de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão, assegurando que as vozes e necessidades dos colaboradores sejam ouvidas e atendidas. Representará a empresa em eventos externos e fóruns relacionados ao tema, e construirá parcerias com organizações externas para promover a diversidade e a inclusão.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Vivência em papel focado no tema (implementação de estratégia, condução de treinamentos e monitoramento do progresso das ações);
  • Experiência utilizando dados e métricas na avaliação de eficácia das iniciativas de DE&I;
  • Proatividade, organização, e perfil hands-on;
  • Inglês avançado.

O que oferecemos:

  • Oportunidade sem precedentes de tomar a saúde diária mais acessível, inclusiva e sustentável ao fazer parte de uma empresa global.
  • Fazer parte de uma companhia que é certificada como Top Employer, sendo reconhecida pela excelência em suas práticas de RH e gestão.
  • Trabalhar com marcas incríveis, como Sensodyne, Centrum, Eno, entre outras.
  • Crescimento contínuo para alcançar seu máximo potencial.
  • Experiências únicas ao trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza a saúde e o bem-estar das pessoas e permite que cada um seja sua melhor versão.

Se sente que esse é seu próximo passo de carreira, inscreva-se até 14/09/2025

Venha fazer parte do nosso time

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Haleon, vamos além das expectativas e impulsionamos uma cultura em que fazemos o que mais importa. Promovemos um ambiente onde a diversidade seja celebrada, a equidade seja praticada e a inclusão seja vivenciada.

Nosso compromisso é humanizar as relações, respeitando à individualidade e garantindo que cada colaborador sinta-se valorizado, incluído e parte essencial de nossa comunidade.

title: Software Engineer, Ceph
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer for Ceph & Distributed Storage. As part of Cloud Engineering, you'll be building modelling software to drive systems such as OpenStack, Ceph, and Kubernetes with a focus on distributed storage and Ceph. You'll be engineering solutions to scale in production, working with our field teams to ensure we're meeting the needs of customers looking to adopt cutting-edge technology.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of the software defined datacenter, distributed systems, and open source. Canonical is a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion, and you will need to work well in that context. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.
This job involves international travel several times a year, usually for one week at a time.

Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or the Americas regions

What your day will look like

  • Write high quality, rigorously designed Python and Golang software
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Contribute to technical documentation that define best practices for authoring high quality operators 
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Develop and maintain software for delivery, operations and life-cycle management of Ceph storage

What we are looking for in you

  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with writing modern, maintainable Python
  • You have experience with Ceph storage
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest and experience with two or more of the following: Linux, Kubernetes, Public cloud, OpenStack, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, Debian packaging
  •  An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  •  Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Experience operating Ceph clusters in production
  • Experience with open source distributed storage such as Gluster, Minio, Mayastor or similar

What we offer you


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Engenheiro Processos Pleno
description:
Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único

Buscamos um Engenheiro Processos Pleno
que será responsável por fornecer conhecimentos e habilidades específicos da disciplina para os ativos operados pela PRIO, assim como, garantir o planejamento e execução das melhores práticas da indústria, assegurando o monitoramento do processo para garantir uma operação segura e eficiente das nossas operações.

A posição é base Botafogo, mas eventuais embarques offshore poderão acontecer para projetos específicos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Elaborar, implementar e monitorar soluções de melhoria contínua e de oportunidades de otimização das operações, incluindo processos químicos e práticas de operação de maneira a manter a produção dos ativos de forma segura e contínua;
  • Coletar e analisar as informações necessárias para a realização das atividades atreladas à troubleshooting de processos, participando ativamente da investigação para a redução dos incidentes operacionais;
  • Elaborar e verificar Procedimentos, Work Packs de atividades ou projetos do time de engenharia;
  • Realizar simulações em HYSYS para garantir que o comportamento da planta de processo esteja de acordo com o esperado. Utiliza também as simulações para base de elaboração de projetos e melhoria de processos;
  • Garantir o bom funcionamento dos fluxos de documentos através das ferramentas de Gestão de Documentos e de Mudanças evitando possíveis não conformidades;
  • Suportar auditorias (ANP, marinha, etc) através do levantamento de informações e elaboração de evidências de cumprimento as diretrizes e legislações vigentes de forma a minimizar possíveis não conformidades e garantindo o tratamento das mesmas;
  • Apoiar revisões de projeto, avaliações de segurança / risco, HAZIDs, HAZOPs, conforme aplicável;
  • Realizar análises de engenharia em falhas de equipamentos/sistemas ou mau-funcionamento e conduzir análises da causa raiz, propondo melhorias para o aumento de performance e vida útil dos equipamentos;
  • Verificar performance de equipamentos (estáticos e rotativos);
  • Participar das reuniões diárias de operações e reuniões para revisão do plano de atividades integradas bem como reuniões de projetos;
  • Manter interface continua com os times: de manutenção, assegurando o funcionamento e desempenho de equipamentos críticos; de engenharia de produção, avaliando possíveis causas para baixas de produção e encontrando soluções para otimização; e times de bordo (offshore), dando todo suporte necessário referente à processos;
  • Suportar e garantir continuidade operacional do processo topside para atender novos projetos/interligações PRIO;
  • Elaborar e verificar divulgação de relatórios de Lições Aprendidas e Awareness.

Requisitos e qualificações
Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico);

  • Formação Superior em Engenharia: Química, Mecânica ou Petróleo

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória;

  • PI
  • Simuladores de Processos (HYSYS)
  • Experiência com FPSOs

Informações adicionais
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas

Dica:
Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo

title: Coordinator, Anti-Piracy/Content Protection
description:
Coordinator, Anti-Piracy/Content Protection

Job Description:

At Warner Music Group, we're a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we know that each talent makes our collective bolder and brighter. We are guided by four core principles that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

  • Music is Everything: Music is our passion, and we can never get enough. Tastes, trends, and tech will change, but great artists and songwriters will always be our driving force.
  • Global Growth, Local Expertise: Music is a global language. Through communication and collaboration, our success can come from anywhere and translate everywhere.
  • Innovation and Insight: Pushing the boundaries requires the best information and the boldest imagination. We use both to create the future.
  • Empowered by People: Like the artists we serve and the music they make, our differences make us stronger. This is a place where every talent can belong and build a career.

We remain committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. We know it fosters a culture where you can truly belong, contribute, and grow. We encourage applications from people of any age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, and any other characteristic or identity.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

Job Title: Coordinator, Anti-Piracy/Content Protection

Reports To: Senior Manager, Global Content Protection

Department: Global Commercial Services

Location: Brazil

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resumes in English

A little bit about our team:

We provide support to our label and territory partners in rights management, optimization, and content protection to ensure maximum revenue opportunities at our commercial digital partners.

Your role:

We're looking for someone who thrives on searching the depths of the internet to find when and where unreleased music first pops up. We want someone to help our artists maintain control of their release plans. This person will be the next piece in building a world-class anti-piracy unit.

Here you'll get to:

  • Monitor and protect all forms of Warner Music Group's intellectual property, including audio, video, physical products, merchandise, and virtual properties
  • Support LatAm region/territory commercial & digital teams on proactive best practices and leak response
  • WMG Content Protection inbox management and coordination with team coverage across timezones
  • Coordinate priority releases on a weekly basis with third-party anti-piracy services
  • Work with label partners on priority release schedules
  • Receive and create leak alerts for infringing uploads
  • Support team leadership on special projects such as researching platforms that infringe on WMG's intellectual property

About you:

  • Strong attention to detail
  • Effectively manage and prioritize multiple projects at one time
  • Learn, dissect and implement new processes, procedures or concepts quickly
  • Stay organized, on task, and self-motivated
  • Think quickly on your feet and work well independently
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • English business fluency written/verbal
  • Comfort with Google Enterprise products (Sheets, Docs, Slides, and Forms) and Microsoft Office Services (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Sharepoint)

We'd love it if you also had:

  • At least 1 year of experience with digital operations, account management, or DSP data
  • College degree preferred

About us:

As the home to 10K Projects, 300 Elektra, Asylum, Atlantic, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world's premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalogue of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Music With Vision & Voice.

Click the "Apply" link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

Don't be discouraged if you don't hear from us right away. We're taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

O Clube de Regatas do Flamengo é um dos maiores e mais tradicionais clubes poliesportivos do Brasil, fundado em 1895 no Rio de Janeiro. Originalmente criado como um clube de remo, o Flamengo alcançou sua maior notoriedade no futebol, onde conquistou títulos históricos como o Mundial Interclubes e a Copa Libertadores de 1981. Reconhecido por suas conquistas no Campeonato Carioca, soma 39 títulos e é um dos clubes mais vitoriosos do Brasil. SOBRE NÓS

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como
"A marca mais amada do Rio"
e por 14 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a
"Marca preferida dos Cariocas"
.

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 11 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.
